summary: Remove the unrelated rbn stem copied into qzf
rationale: The qzf head and stem I describe jumping (qazəf/qozəf). This additional stem instead has mrabanle/mraban, the gloss “to raise”, and an example of raising children. The stray notes “r” and “Rbn” mark the root boundary. A targeted lookup shows that the separate entry r, headed by the note Rbn, already preserves this same stem, gloss and example verbatim. Remove the duplicate foreign section from qzf while retaining that separate record.
